responseMessageContents.text:
Understood — you're locked out of AWS because of an MFA issue. That makes the S3 upload impossible right now. But we have a working v1.4.37 APK already live, and v1.4.38 is built. We need to make a pragmatic choice.

Here are the options:

## Option A: Skip the APK upload for now (recommended)
- Keep the v1.4.37 APK live at `https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.37.apk` (verified real binary, 83.6 MB)
- The v1.4.38 build is complete and ready in the repo
- Move forward with the remaining brand standardization phases (5, 6, 10, 13, 14)
- Upload v1.4.38 to S3 later when AWS MFA is fixed

## Option B: Try to recover AWS access
- AWS Support has a dedicated MFA recovery form at `https://aws.amazon.com/forms/aws-mfa-support`
- Since you already have a case, they can also deactivate the MFA device if you verify identity
- This will take time and is outside the app work

## Option C: Use an alternative upload path
- I can check if there's an existing deployment endpoint that uses a different S3 bucket, Cloudflare R2, or signed upload path
- But the current `ivxholding.com` bucket is the only one in the code

I also noticed a critical issue from the full env audit: **GITHUB_TOKEN is still the old revoked token** `ghp_tzBu...` on Render. The AWS problem is separate, but the GitHub token is still blocking autonomous deploys.

**My recommendation:**
1. Let AWS MFA stay pending — you already have AWS Support involved
2. I'll mark Phase 12 (build/deploy) as partially complete with a note that APK upload is blocked by AWS MFA
3. We continue with Phase 5 (IVX IA Chat branding) and Phase 6 (Business/doc branding)
4. Meanwhile, you handle the GitHub token replacement when you have a moment

Should I proceed with Phase 5 / 6 while the AWS recovery is in progress? Or do you want to focus on the GitHub token replacement first to unblock the autonomous deploy chain?
